checklist.detail: The exact selected binary reported grok 1.0.5 (5115b46bc9) [stable] immediately before the isolated run; the host default and validated versions matched.
The production launch emitted --permission-mode bypassPermissions and the transcript recorded yolo_mode=true.
PtyConfig emitted a fresh bare UUID through both --session-id and CAS_SESSION_ID; the same ID named the live transcript.
The production launch emitted grok-4.5 with medium reasoning effort and the assistant transcript recorded both.
Both the process cwd and --cwd targeted the disposable repository; prompt_context.json recorded the same working directory.
The production --rules payload appeared in system_prompt.txt and drove the Cassy worker startup/lifecycle contract with the cas__ namespace.
Persistent config discovered cas serve, connected at least 11 tools, and the worker invoked cas__coordination and cas__task rather than Claude/Codex aliases.
Inherited CAS agent, role, factory, session, root, worker CLI, model, and effort environment bound cas serve to the disposable store and registered the expected Grok worker.
The session was written under ~/.grok/sessions/*/<session-id>; its post-submit turn_ended event cleared Pane in-flight state through the production liveness resolver.
The worker called whoami, mine, show, start, and notes; wrote the exact probe marker; committed it with the versioned lifecycle subject; and left the disposable repository clean.
Grok inspect reported every discovered Claude/Cursor-compatible hook disabled, the live run retained CAS role/identity through --rules plus env, and the SessionStart hook canary did not execute.
